name: Token Insights
description: A private local scanner for PI-Desktop, Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode token metadata, with per-tool trends, categories, and encouraging streaks.
author: PI-Desktop
changelog: Multi-tool local scanning: adds Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode adapters, tool-source categories, and a schema-v2 snapshot while preserving multilingual and light/dark theme support.
safetyNotes: Scans only supported local tool metadata locations. It aggregates usage, time, tool source, model, provider, and short session IDs; it does not retain or expose message content, tool arguments, project paths, or full session IDs, and it makes no network requests.

agentTools.name: token_usage_summary
agentTools.description: Scan supported local AI-tool metadata and summarize token usage by tool source, model, provider, day, or short session ID without returning message text.

since.description: Start of the window, inclusive. ISO date or date-time (2026-07-01), or a relative shorthand such as 7d, 30d, 12w, 1y.

until.description: End of the window, exclusive. ISO date or date-time. Defaults to now.

groupBy.description: Which ranking to expand in the reply. Defaults to model.

limit.description: Max rows in the expanded ranking (default 10, max 25).
